name: picohttpparser
license: MIT OR Perl (dual-licensed: source header states 'either the MIT License (below) or the Perl license'); no SPDX tag in tree
license_file: no standalone LICENSE file at this revision; dual-license text in vendor/src/picohttpparser/picohttpparser.c lines 1-24 and vendor/src/picohttpparser/picohttpparser.h lines 1-24
build_command: clang -O2 -Wall -c vendor/src/picohttpparser/picohttpparser.c -o vendor/build/picohttpparser-clang/picohttpparser.o && ar rcs vendor/build/picohttpparser-clang/libpicohttpparser.a vendor/build/picohttpparser-clang/picohttpparser.o && clang -O2 -std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -D_GNU_SOURCE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pthread vendor/build/picohttpparser-clang/probe.c -I vendor/src/picohttpparser vendor/build/picohttpparser-clang/libpicohttpparser.a -o vendor/build/picohttpparser-clang/probe
probe_log_tail:
== probe ==
valid_request ret=63 input_len=63
  consumed=63 method="GET" path="/hello?x=1" minor_version=1 num_headers=2
  header[0] name_len=4 name="Host" value_len=11 value="example.com"
  header[1] name_len=6 name="X-Test" value_len=7 value="abc def"
incomplete_request(10 bytes) ret=-2 (observed)
malformed_request(no HTTP version) ret=-1 (observed)
control_char_header ret=-1 (observed, informational)
probe_result=PASS
probe exit=0
notes: Exact observed parser behavior: valid 'GET /hello?x=1 HTTP/1.1' with Host and X-Test parsed returning 63 (all bytes consumed); method/path pointers are non-NUL-terminated, lengths must be used; minor_version=1; 2 headers with leading space after ':' and CRLF stripped from values. Incomplete input (10 of 63 bytes) returns -2. Malformed request without an HTTP version ('GET /\r\n\r\n') returns -1. A control byte (0x01) inside a header name is also rejected with -1. ph_parse_request returns >0 = bytes consumed, -2 = incomplete, -1 = parse error. Upstream compiles warning-free with -O2 -Wall.
